policy.game_images: Remote official links only; do not redistribute or use as direct generation inputs.
policy.downloaded_assets: Reference-only CC0 copies; not imported by Godot and not approved production art.
policy.excluded: Unclear licenses, ripped sprites, aggregators without primary proof, and AI stock dumps.
